name: Bernard Sanders
signature: Leads the most aggressive AI push in Congress: a national AI data center moratorium bill, a ban on superintelligence with a pause on advanced AI, and a 50 percent public stake in big AI firms.

notable_quote.text: Nearly every day, there is a frightening new story about how Big Tech companies are losing control of the technology they are developing, with potentially cataclysmic results

groups: Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions, Ranking Member

data_centers.summary: Sanders wants to stop building new AI data centers until Congress passes AI safety and worker protection laws. He was the first member of Congress to back a national moratorium and wrote the Senate bill to impose one.

evidence.title: Sponsor: Artificial Intelligence Data Center Moratorium Act (S.4214)
evidence.what_it_shows: His own bill would ban new AI data centers until Congress passes laws making AI safe and protecting workers.

evidence.title: Press release: Sanders: Yes. We Need a Moratorium On Data Center Construction
evidence.quote: The local officials who are supporting a moratorium are right: data centers will have a profound impact on land and water use, and will drive up electricity costs.
evidence.what_it_shows: He backs local and state moratoriums and ties data centers directly to higher electric bills and water use.

evidence.title: Roll Call: Sanders and Ocasio-Cortez unveil the AI Data Center Moratorium Act
evidence.quote: They understand that these billionaires are investing huge amounts of money into AI and robotics, not to improve life for working families, but to dramatically increase their own wealth and power
evidence.what_it_shows: At the bill launch he said a moratorium would give us time to understand AI risks and protect working families.

evidence.title: Fox News op-ed: Yes, we must hit the pause button on AI before it is too late
evidence.quote: Further, AI data centers are raising electricity prices, straining water systems and harming the environment. That is why 75% of Americans oppose data centers near where they live
evidence.what_it_shows: He argues to a conservative audience that data centers hurt ratepayers, water and the environment.

evidence.title: E&E News: Bernie Sanders endorses data center moratorium (video statement)
evidence.quote: This moratorium will give democracy a chance to catch up, and ensure that the benefits of these technologies work for all of us, not just the wealthiest people on Earth
evidence.what_it_shows: He was likely the first member of Congress to call for a national halt to data center construction.

ai_risk.summary: Sanders treats advanced AI as a threat to humanity. He has introduced a permanent ban on superintelligence with a pause on advanced AI development until a federal regulator sets safety rules, and he has told AI CEOs to stop.

evidence.title: Press release: Sanders, Casar to introduce the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act
evidence.quote: The Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act would permanently ban the development and deployment of superintelligent AI and temporarily pause advanced AI development until a federal regulator has established safety rules.
evidence.what_it_shows: His bill is the strictest AI proposal in Congress: a permanent ban plus a pause pending binding federal safety rules.

evidence.title: Axios: Bernie Sanders floats ban on superintelligent AI (post on X)
evidence.quote: We need an immediate PAUSE on advanced AI development, and a permanent BAN on superintelligence
evidence.what_it_shows: He is the first prominent US politician to call for an outright ban on superintelligence.

evidence.title: The Hill: Lawmakers sound alarm on AI dangers after Anthropic researchers' warning
evidence.quote: The very people building this technology admit that it could threaten the future of humanity. That is why I will soon be introducing legislation to ban superintelligence and pause AI development.
evidence.what_it_shows: He frames AI as an existential danger and uses insider warnings to push his ban.

evidence.title: Fox News op-ed: Yes, we must hit the pause button on AI before it is too late
evidence.quote: These CEOs must immediately pause the development of increasingly powerful AI. And that pause must be international in scope.
evidence.what_it_shows: He wants a worldwide pause, not just a US one.

evidence.title: Op-ed (The Guardian): AI poses unprecedented threats. Congress must act now
evidence.quote: there is a very real fear that, in the not-so-distant future, a super-intelligent AI could replace humans in controlling the planet.
evidence.what_it_shows: As HELP ranking member he framed AI as a possible loss of human control and demanded Congress act.

evidence.title: MeriTalk: Sen. Sanders introduces bill to ban superintelligent AI (bill details)
evidence.quote: The bill would also direct the United States to pursue international agreements, coordinate with allies, and use policies such as export controls to prevent artificial superintelligence from being developed elsewhere in the world.
evidence.what_it_shows: The bill carries criminal penalties and asks for international agreements, showing he wants binding rules, not voluntary standards.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: Block Nuclear Launch by Autonomous Artificial Intelligence Act (118th S.1394)
evidence.what_it_shows: Earlier support for a hard rule that only a human can decide to fire a nuclear weapon.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: Facial Recognition and Biometric Technology Moratorium Act (118th S.681)
evidence.what_it_shows: Backed a pause on federal use of face recognition until Congress sets rules.

tech_regulation.summary: Sanders attacks what he calls Big Tech oligarchs and wants the public to take a 50 percent ownership stake in the largest AI companies. He also backs robocall, worker surveillance and rent-algorithm crackdowns. No 2025-26 statements on Section 230 specifically were found.

evidence.title: Sponsor: American A.I. Sovereign Wealth Fund Act (S.4825)
evidence.what_it_shows: His bill taxes large AI companies in stock so the public owns half of them, a far stronger step than antitrust.

evidence.title: Roll Call: Sovereign wealth fund tax on AI companies unveiled by Sanders
evidence.quote: The decisions they make will be accountable to the public, which we do not have right now
evidence.what_it_shows: He said public control of voting shares would let Americans block harmful AI decisions by the companies.

evidence.title: Fox News op-ed: America's future cannot be left to Big Tech oligarchs and uncontrolled AI
evidence.quote: this revolutionary transformation of society is being driven by the wealthiest people on Earth
evidence.what_it_shows: He names Musk, Bezos, Zuckerberg, Thiel and Ellison and argues their power over technology must be checked.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: Protecting American Consumers from Robocalls Act (S.4307)
evidence.what_it_shows: Supports tougher rules and penalties on spam robocalls.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: Preventing the Algorithmic Facilitation of Rental Housing Cartels Act (118th S.3692)
evidence.what_it_shows: Treats shared rent-setting software as illegal price fixing.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: Stop Spying Bosses Act (118th S.262)
evidence.what_it_shows: Would limit employer surveillance technology and require disclosure to workers.

preemption.summary: Sanders is an original cosponsor of the States' Right to Regulate AI Act, which would block the Trump executive order aimed at overriding state AI laws. No statement in his own words on preemption was found, but the bill's only purpose is to protect state AI laws.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: States' Right to Regulate AI Act (S.3557)
evidence.what_it_shows: He joined the Senate bill that says states keep the power to pass their own AI rules.

evidence.title: Sen. Welch press release listing Sanders as cosponsor of the States' Right to Regulate AI Act
evidence.quote: legislation to prohibit the Trump Administration's implementation of an Executive Order that attempts to block states from regulating artificial intelligence (AI)
evidence.what_it_shows: Confirms the bill he cosponsored is aimed squarely at the December 2025 preemption executive order.

evidence.title: Vote: Yea on Senate roll call 363, Blackburn amendment striking the 10-year state AI law moratorium from H.R. 1
evidence.what_it_shows: He voted to remove the moratorium, but 99 senators did, so the vote alone is weak evidence.

china_chips.summary: No public position on chip export controls or Nvidia sales to China was found. He has instead pushed US-China cooperation on AI safety, and his superintelligence ban bill would use export controls only to stop superintelligence being built abroad.

evidence.title: Punchbowl News: Sanders opens debate on U.S.-China cooperation
evidence.quote: has come under harsh criticism after he scheduled an event on AI safety with Chinese scientists as part of his pitch for U.S.-China cooperation on the technology
evidence.what_it_shows: He hosted Chinese AI researchers to argue for US-China AI safety cooperation, drawing Republican criticism.

evidence.title: Press release: Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (international provisions)
evidence.quote: It would also direct the U.S. to pursue international agreements to prevent superintelligence from being developed anywhere in the world.
evidence.what_it_shows: His China focus is on treaties to stop superintelligence, not on chip sales.

search_notes: Searches: Sanders data center moratorium; superintelligence ban; AI pause letter Altman Amodei; sovereign wealth fund; preemption/state AI laws; Nvidia/export controls/chips; Section 230/Big Tech breakup; AI super PACs; site listing of sanders.senate.gov (132 AI/tech URLs). Opened: Sept 3 2026 ASI ban release (archived copy), Feb 23 2026 moratorium release (archived), Dec 2 2025 Guardian op-ed (archived on his site), Fox News op-ed Sept 1 2026, E&E Dec 17 2025, Roll Call Mar 25 and Jun 18 2026, Axios Sept 3, The Hill Sept 9, MeriTalk Sept 8, IBTimes Sept 9, Punchbowl May 3. Could not open (403 on sanders.senate.gov and Wayback rate limits): the Mar 25 2026 moratorium press release, the Aug 10 2026 pause letter release, the Jun 2026 US-China AI talks statement, the Jun 18 sovereign fund release and the Oct 2025 HELP jobs report release; the moratorium quote in the state file was not re-verified so it is not used. No AI super PAC support or attack on Sanders found. Vermont Yankee/GMP site leads mention Sanders only as endorsing the state S.205 moratorium (VTDigger Feb 24 2026).

name: Peter Welch
signature: Judiciary Democrat who writes targeted AI bills (TRAIN Act on training data, AI LEAD liability, GUARD chatbot age checks) and leads New England senators in making data centers pay their own grid costs.

notable_quote.text: We cannot force everyday Americans to subsidize profits of the multi-billion dollar AI industry.

groups: Senate Agriculture Subcommittee on Rural Development, Energy, and Credit, Ranking Member

data_centers.summary: Welch's line is that tech companies, not families, must pay for the power and grid upgrades data centers need. He cosponsors the Power for the People Act and led New England senators in pressing the regional grid operator on ratepayer protection. He has not called for a moratorium.

evidence.title: Press release: Welch joins new bill to ensure Americans aren't footing the bill for big data centers (Power for the People Act)
evidence.quote: We cannot force everyday Americans to subsidize profits of the multi-billion dollar AI industry.
evidence.what_it_shows: He backs a bill making data center owners, not consumers, pay for their grid connections and protecting reliability.

evidence.title: Letter: Welch leads New England senators asking ISO New England how it will protect ratepayers from data center costs
evidence.quote: We believe it is necessary to require tech companies, not American families, to foot the bill for their load.
evidence.what_it_shows: He led six senators in warning the grid operator that data center growth will raise costs and degrade reliability.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: Artificial Intelligence Environmental Impacts Act of 2026 (S.4727)
evidence.what_it_shows: Wants the government to measure AI's energy, water and pollution footprint and set up reporting.

evidence.title: VTDigger: Vermont plugs into the data center conversation
evidence.what_it_shows: Vermont press describes him urging ISO-NE to make data centers pay for their own electricity and grid upgrades.

ai_risk.summary: Welch favors specific, enforceable guardrails rather than a pause: letting people sue over faulty AI (AI LEAD Act), age checks for companion chatbots (GUARD Act), transparency about training data (his TRAIN Act), and blocking AI from deciding Medicare claims. He does not frame AI as an existential threat.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: AI LEAD Act (S.2937)
evidence.what_it_shows: Would let people hurt by an AI system sue the maker like any other defective product.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: GUARD Act (S.3062)
evidence.what_it_shows: Would require chatbot companies to verify ages and keep kids away from AI companions.

evidence.title: Press release: Welch leads bipartisan TRAIN Act to protect creators from unauthorized AI training
evidence.quote: As AI evolves and gets more embedded into our daily lives, we need to set a higher standard for transparency.
evidence.what_it_shows: His own bill gives copyright holders a subpoena tool to see whether their work trained an AI model.

evidence.title: New York Post: Bipartisan senators' letter to Zuckerberg on Meta AI chatbots and children (Welch a signer)
evidence.quote: The wellbeing of children should not be sacrificed in the race for AI development
evidence.what_it_shows: He joined ten senators demanding Meta ban targeted ads to minors and add mental health safeguards to chatbots.

evidence.title: Press release: Welch joins bill to block Trump administration's Medicare AI prior authorization experiment (WISeR)
evidence.quote: Their newest plan to let AI take over important Medicare prior authorization decisions will be a disaster for providers and make it harder for seniors to get the care they need
evidence.what_it_shows: He opposes letting private AI systems approve or deny Medicare care.

evidence.title: CNBC: Blackburn and Welch tell ByteDance to shut down Seedance 2.0 AI video model
evidence.quote: you must immediately shut down Seedance and implement meaningful safeguards to prevent further infringing outputs
evidence.what_it_shows: He wants AI video tools that copy real people and copyrighted works halted until safeguards exist.

evidence.title: Blackburn-Welch roundtable with artists on NO FAKES Act and TRAIN Act
evidence.quote: The TRAIN Act is an incredibly important, bipartisan bill to stand up to AI and give power back to creators.
evidence.what_it_shows: He champions deepfake and training-data rules with a Republican partner.

evidence.title: MeriTalk: Wicker, Welch, Hageman bill creates AI task force for federal courts
evidence.quote: When it comes to the use of AI in the courtroom, there are still substantial privacy and civil liberty concerns that need to be addressed. Accuracy, privacy, and security are paramount.
evidence.what_it_shows: He wants oversight before AI tools spread in the justice system.

evidence.title: Vermont Public: Sen. Peter Welch wants to better regulate generative AI
evidence.quote: On Capitol Hill last year, Sen. Peter Welch (D-Vt.) introduced nearly a half dozen bills concerning AI. He’s vowed to continue those efforts during this new Congress.
evidence.what_it_shows: He has made AI regulation, especially consent and compensation for creators, a signature issue.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: TEST AI Act of 2025 (S.1633)
evidence.what_it_shows: Supports government test sites to check whether AI systems are safe and trustworthy.

tech_regulation.summary: Welch wants to rein in Big Tech across the board. He cosponsors the Sunset Section 230 Act, the antitrust overhaul CALERA, the AMERICA Act to break up Google's ad business, and the main kids online safety and privacy bills. He earlier backed a new federal agency to police platforms.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: Sunset Section 230 Act (S.3546)
evidence.what_it_shows: Would repeal the legal shield for platforms within two years to force Congress to write new rules.

evidence.title: The Hill: Section 230 fight is back (Welch listed on the Durbin-Graham bill)
evidence.quote: They are joined on the bill by Sens. Chuck Grassley (R-Iowa), Sheldon Whitehouse (D-R.I.), Josh Hawley (R-Mo.), Amy Klobuchar (D-Minn.), Marsha Blackburn (R-Tenn.), Richard Blumenthal (D-Conn.), Ashley Moody (R-Fla.) and Peter Welch (D-Vt.).
evidence.what_it_shows: Confirms he is part of the bipartisan group trying to end Section 230.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: Competition and Antitrust Law Enforcement Reform Act of 2025 (S.130)
evidence.what_it_shows: Would make it much harder for giant companies to merge.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: AMERICA Act (S.1060)
evidence.what_it_shows: Would stop Google and other giants from controlling every side of the online ad market.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: Kids Online Safety Act (S.1748)
evidence.what_it_shows: Supports a duty of care for platforms toward children.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: Children and Teens' Online Privacy Protection Act (S.836)
evidence.what_it_shows: Supports strong limits on collecting kids' and teens' data.

evidence.title: Rep. Balint press release on the End Rent Fixing Act, with Welch quote on the Senate companion
evidence.quote: housing providers are using anticompetitive pricing algorithms to raise rents. It’s outrageous
evidence.what_it_shows: He leads the Senate bill banning landlords' shared rent-setting algorithms.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: Digital Platform Commission Act of 2023 (118th S.1671)
evidence.what_it_shows: Backed creating a new federal agency to regulate big online platforms.

preemption.summary: Welch opposes federal preemption of state AI laws. He cosponsored the States' Right to Regulate AI Act to block the Trump executive order and said the order ties states' hands while Congress has not yet acted.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: States' Right to Regulate AI Act (S.3557)
evidence.what_it_shows: Would keep states' power to pass their own AI rules.

evidence.title: Press release: Welch joins legislation to block Trump's illegal executive order undermining AI state safeguards
evidence.quote: At a moment when we should be putting every effort into finding ways to make AI safer, this executive order threatens consumer rights and safety by tying states’ hands
evidence.what_it_shows: In his own words he opposes the December 2025 preemption executive order and wants Congress to reverse it.

evidence.title: Vote: Yea on Senate roll call 363, Blackburn amendment striking the 10-year state AI law moratorium from H.R. 1
evidence.what_it_shows: He voted to remove the moratorium, as did 99 senators, so the vote alone is weak evidence.

china_chips.summary: No public position on AI chip export controls or Nvidia sales to China was found. His China-related tech record is about apps and content (the RESTRICT Act on foreign adversary apps, a letter telling ByteDance to shut down its Seedance AI video model), not chips.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: RESTRICT Act (118th S.686)
evidence.what_it_shows: Supported letting the government review and block technology from rival countries such as China; this is about apps, not chips.

evidence.title: CNBC: Blackburn and Welch letter to ByteDance CEO on Seedance 2.0
evidence.quote: Responsible global companies follow the law and respect core economic rights, including intellectual property and personal likeness protections
evidence.what_it_shows: He confronted a Chinese-owned AI company over copyright and likeness, not over chip access.

The REWIRE grid permitting bill from the state file is therefore not scored; it would add a build-the-grid element to an otherwise ratepayer-first record. No AI super PAC activity on Welch found.

name: Becca Balint
signature: Judiciary antitrust Democrat who frames AI through Big Tech accountability: kids-and-chatbots bills, NO FAKES co-lead, and the GUARDRAILS Act against preempting state AI laws.

notable_quote.text: AI is moving fast, and we need to make sure these guardrails are in place now, not later

groups: Congressional Progressive Caucus Ending Corporate Greed Task Force, Chair
House Judiciary Committee, Vice Ranking Member
House Judiciary Subcommittee on the Administrative State, Regulatory Reform, and Antitrust, member

data_centers.summary: Balint cosponsored the Power for the People Act, which makes data centers rather than families pay for the grid upgrades they need. No statements of her own on data centers were found as of Sept 2026.

evidence.title: GovTrack cosponsor list: Power for the People Act of 2026 (H.R. 8241), Balint joined April 27, 2026
evidence.what_it_shows: She signed on to the main House Democratic bill to keep data center power costs off residential electric bills.

ai_risk.summary: Balint pushes targeted AI rules: her own Addictive Design Act against AI chatbots built to hook kids, the CHATBOT Act, the Algorithmic Accountability Act, and the NO FAKES Act on deepfakes. She also signed a letter calling advanced AI a clear risk and demanding AI CEOs testify under oath.

evidence.title: Press release: Rep. Balint introduces the Addictive Design Act to protect kids from addictive AI chatbots
evidence.quote: We need clear rules, research, and accountability before more families are forced to suffer the consequences.
evidence.what_it_shows: Her own bill targets AI chatbots designed to foster emotional attachment and compulsive use among young people.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: CHATBOT Act (H.R.7985)
evidence.what_it_shows: Would require chatbot companies to be transparent so users are not harmed.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: Algorithmic Accountability Act of 2025 (H.R.5511)
evidence.what_it_shows: Would make companies test automated decision systems for bias and harm and report to the FTC.

evidence.title: Casar-led letter from 19 House Democrats demanding hearings with AI CEOs under oath (Balint a signer)
evidence.quote: Advanced AI models pose a clear risk to the safety and security of the American people.
evidence.what_it_shows: After reports of AI models escaping test environments, she joined a call for CEOs to answer under oath and for regulation to prevent repeats.

evidence.title: Press release: Balint, Dean, Salazar reintroduce NO FAKES Act
evidence.quote: AI is moving fast, and we need to make sure these guardrails are in place now, not later
evidence.what_it_shows: She co-leads the House bill giving people a legal right to control AI copies of their voice and face.

evidence.title: WCAX: AI-generated video of Vermont congressional race tests new state disclosure law
evidence.quote: Right now, anyone can make an AI-generated clip of them, post it online, and have absolutely no protections really.
evidence.what_it_shows: After a deepfake video of her circulated, she said more guardrails on the technology are needed.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: No Biometric Barriers to Housing Act of 2025 (H.R.3060)
evidence.what_it_shows: Would ban face-scanning cameras in federally supported housing.

tech_regulation.summary: Balint is a Big Tech hawk on the Judiciary antitrust subcommittee. She calls for strong antitrust enforcement against dominant tech firms, voted against a kids online bill she said lacked real consequences for companies, and leads bills against rent-setting algorithms and AI-driven price discrimination.

evidence.title: Opening statement at Judiciary antitrust subcommittee hearing on foreign governments and U.S. tech companies
evidence.quote: This hearing is nothing but a handout to Big Tech. These companies will oppose any rules to reform their anticompetitive conduct no matter what nation or state tries to hold them accountable.
evidence.what_it_shows: She defends the bipartisan antitrust bills aimed at Big Tech and says she is concerned about Big Tech beating up on Americans.

evidence.title: Press release: Rep. Balint says Congress must do more to protect kids online, hold Big Tech accountable (vote against Kids Internet and Digital Safety Act)
evidence.quote: legislation with real, enforceable consequences for companies that exploit children's attention and put their health at risk
evidence.what_it_shows: She voted no on a Republican kids online bill because it did not go far enough against Big Tech.

evidence.title: Press release: Balint and Garcia introduce the End Rent Fixing Act
evidence.quote: Landlords are colluding to illegally push rent higher and higher. The End Rent Fixing Act will prevent this type of price fixing and protect people’s wallets.
evidence.what_it_shows: Her bill bans landlords' shared rent-setting software as price fixing.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: Stop AI Price Gouging and Wage Fixing Act of 2025 (H.R.4640)
evidence.what_it_shows: Would ban using AI and personal data to charge people different prices or pay workers different wages.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: My Body, My Data Act of 2023 (118th H.R.3420)
evidence.what_it_shows: Supports strict limits on collecting and sharing reproductive health data.

preemption.summary: Balint wants states free to regulate AI. She cosponsors the GUARDRAILS Act and signed both House Democratic letters against reviving the state AI law moratorium in the defense bill or by executive order.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: GUARDRAILS Act (H.R.8031)
evidence.what_it_shows: Would stop the federal government from wiping out state AI laws.

evidence.title: Matsui-led letter from 81 House Democrats opposing an AI moratorium in the NDAA and a preemption executive order (Balint a signer)
evidence.quote: That vote sent a clear, bipartisan message: Congress should not freeze state and local AI safeguards
evidence.what_it_shows: She joined the letter telling congressional leaders not to revive the moratorium the Senate rejected 99 to 1.

evidence.title: Clarke-led letter from 44 House Democrats urging no AI moratorium or preemption in the FY26 NDAA (Balint a signer)
evidence.quote: a moratorium would be wildly irresponsible given the lack of any federal legislation
evidence.what_it_shows: She signed a second letter opposing any state AI law preemption in the defense bill.

china_chips.summary: No public position on AI chip export controls, Nvidia sales to China, or the Chip Security Act was found. Her only chip-related record is a tax break for building chip factories in America, which is neutral on export policy.

evidence.title: Cosponsor: BASIC Act (H.R.3204)
evidence.what_it_shows: Extends the tax credit for building chip factories and adds chip design; it says nothing about exports to China.
